name: list-paste
title: List Paste
description: Paste box that splits on lines, commas, semicolons and tabs (keeping "Shah, Priya" <…> whole), counts valid, duplicate and invalid items with the line and reason for each, and removes the bad ones in one undoable tap. Validator is pluggable.

meta.summary: Splits a pasted list of emails or names, counts valid, duplicate and invalid items, and removes the bad ones before you import or invite.
catches: Items split wrongly by commas inside quoted names
Duplicates, by a compare key you choose
Invalid items with their line and reason
Invisible characters and Name <email> wrappers stripped
limits: Default email check is pragmatic (one @, dotted domain, no spaces), not full RFC 5322 or a deliverability check
a11y: Visible label; textarea is described by a polite summary region
Remove buttons have aria-labels with the count they remove
Undo is a real button; icons are aria-hidden
